answer: A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, which means a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Promotion is logged in horizon and hollow recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 10 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the kernel. A 444 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
